annotation.title_clean: Declaration of Montevideo: For the construction of a regional approach on the governance of Artificial Intelligence and its impacts on our society
annotation.title_en: Declaration of Montevideo: For the construction of a regional approach on the governance of Artificial Intelligence and its impacts on our society
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministers and High-Level Authorities, Second Ministerial and High-Level Authorities Summit on the Ethics of AI in Latin America and the Caribbean (with UNESCO, CAF, AGESIC Uruguay)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Ministerial declaration from the October 2024 Montevideo summit on AI ethics in Latin America and the Caribbean. It approves a regional Roadmap with five priority areas, consolidates a permanent Working Group, makes the summit annual, and relies on UNESCO and CAF technical support. It contains no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves a regional AI ethics Roadmap with prioritized areas
Priority areas: governance and regulation, talent and work, vulnerable groups, environment and climate, infrastructure
Consolidates a permanent Working Group on AI Ethics, with Uruguay taking over from Chile
Makes the ministerial summit an annual meeting
UNESCO and CAF act as technical secretariat; UNESCO RAM supports regional diagnosis
